The original always listens on port 3000, calls OpenRouter's address, and reaches SerpApi through the serpapi package, which always calls https://serpapi.com. The copy that produced these cases listens on PORT and prints it, falling back to 3000, a two-line change in src/index.ts, reads OPENAI_BASE_URL first in the OpenRouter service, a one-line change, and, when SERPAPI_BASE_URL is set, points the serpapi package's host, port, and HTTP agent to it, a few lines at the top of the SerpApi service that leave its requests and errors unchanged. The researcher's answer without a tool call and the responder's answer that follows it are synthesized in the recorded format.
